excerpts: All side quests (Gallowmere, Tanner's Fever, Breaking Weir, Advocate's Case, Cold Forge, Dawn Beacon)
Quest structure across The Tanner's Fever / The Breaking Weir / The Advocate's Case / The Cold Forge

Same underlying template (gather 2-3 items/evidence, apply each via one skill check, then a capstone action) repeats across quests; strong flavor text disguises it but it becomes predictable by the third instance.

Identical three-beat structure (gather flat stat bonuses, then a forced linear skill/combat gauntlet, then one ending) repeats across every quest, reducing mechanical variety despite strong prose variety.
